# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| main    | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

Only the `main` branch receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public issue.** Use a private channel:

- **Preferred:** GitHub Security Advisories — "Report a vulnerability" on https://github.com/athmabhiram1/prompt_ware/security/advisories/new (private).
- **Placeholder contact:** `security@example.invalid` — this is a placeholder reporting channel (no real email); replace with a monitored address before production. Do not send real reports to this address.

We acknowledge within 3 business days and aim to ship a fix as a patch release with credit in release notes (no bug-bounty).

See also `SECURITY.md` at the repository root for hardening details (`trufflehog --only-verified`, `npm audit`, `pip-audit`, request limits, and security headers).
